Investigation portfolio

Evidence of how I think

Each project follows a SOC workflow: detect, validate, scope, contain, document, and improve.

01Completed lab

SSH brute-force investigation

Generated repeated authentication failures from Kali, ingested Linux auth logs into Splunk, extracted source IPs, built a five-minute threshold detection, and investigated whether the activity progressed to a successful login.

  • Splunk SPL correlation
  • Source and account scoping
  • True-positive validation
  • Dashboard and alert logic
Analyst conclusionEscalate when failed attempts are followed by success, privileged access, or lateral movement.
